env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Materialize a shipped .lgo package outside the fixed support set.
# Use the real port so the test does not write into GOROOT.

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^count: 42$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/expect/expect.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/expect/expect_test.go
! grep '^//go:build' out/_logos_deps/rt/expect/expect.go
grep 'gosuda/loGos/rt/expect' out/main.go

cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/gorootdep

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/expect"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(expect.FieldText("count", 42))
}
